div.style: color: rgb(245, 127, 23) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

Middleware RateLimit
jendela geser Redis + Lua atomik
default: 60/menit/IP
login: 10/menit
daftar: 5/menit
kode verifikasi: 1/60 detik/ponsel

div.style: color: rgb(27, 94, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

Middleware Auth
JWT Bearer Token (7 hari)
JWT_SECRET_KEY dipaksakan
hilang/default publik → tolak start
hash kata sandi bcrypt
refresh Token + daftar hitam
kunci login: 5 gagal → 15 menit
maks 3 token bersamaan
